rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose causative way to say that something greatly surprised someone.

example.english: This result was enough to astonish me.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 git3 gwo2 ling6 ngo5 hou2 ji3 ngoi6

rows.note: Use this colloquial form when the astonishment is sudden or shocking and may suggest being startled or frightened.

example.english: You suddenly stood behind me—you really did astonish me!
example.traditional: 你突然企喺我後面，真係嚇親我喇！
example.jyutping: nei5 dat6 jin4 kei5 hai2 ngo5 hau6 min6 zan1 hai6 haak3 can1 ngo5 laa3
